1981-2415-3025-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Defiant Salvager's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1531-1981-2415-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Deathgreeter and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Deathgreeter trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing it to become a Spirit artifact creature in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat.

141-2438-3905.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2438-3905.description:
Cast Unbreakable Bond by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Unbreakable Bond.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Unbreakable Bond
Resolve the Unbreakable Bond copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

777-1170-4779-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
777-1170-4779-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Foundry Inspector.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing the artifact, giving Krark-Clan Grunt +1/+0 and first strike until end of turn
Repeat.

2034-5003-7905.easyPrerequisites: You do not control an Army.
2034-5003-7905.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Rhovanion Rampager, adding {C}{C}.
When Rhovanion Rampager dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger,
Resolve the Rhovanion Rampager trigger, creating a creature token.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Rhovanion Rampager from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

1991-3259-7060.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1991-3259-7060.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Tana, triggering Breath of Fury and Tana.
Resolve the Tana trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1987-2187-2510.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
1987-2187-2510.notablePrerequisites: There is an instant card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
1987-2187-2510.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Possessed Skaab.
When Possessed Skaab enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2187-2510.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

2079-6723-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
2079-6723-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
2079-6723-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

527-4499-5434.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Selvala.
Repeat.

4559-5315-7306-7430.notablePrerequisites:
Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
You've had two creatures die under your control this turn.
4559-5315-7306-7430.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gorma.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.

Resolve The Ooze's trigger, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve Gorma's trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

955-3259-3986.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control creatures with total power 6 or greater that can attack this combat.
955-3259-3986.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Battle Cry Goblin as attackers. If needed, declare more creatures as attackers to ensure that the total power of attacking creatures is 6 or greater.
Battle Cry Goblin triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

339-677-1251-6974.manaNeeded: {3} if Ashling's Command is in your hand
339-677-1251-6974.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
If Ashling's Command is in your graveyard, activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Ashling's Command from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. Otherwise, cast Ashling's Command by paying {3}{U}{R}.
Resolve Ashling's Command, creating a token copy of Jegantha and choosing any of its remaining modes.
Put the tapped Jegantha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat using the Jegantha token.

Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

2906-4594-7070.description:
Activate Spirit en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Spirit en-Kor.
The Spirit en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Spirit en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Rakdos.
Repeat.

2024-3918-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures that share a creature type.

1383-4827-5313.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 25.
1383-4827-5313.description:
Activate Evra by paying {4}, exchanging its power with your life total.
If your life total is 4 or higher, activate Treasonous Ogre by paying 3 life, adding {R}.
Repeat step 2 until your life total is 3 or less.
Activate Evra by paying {4}, exchanging its power with your life total. When this occurs, you will gain life equal to the difference between your life total and Evra's power, which will then be doubled by Phial of Galadriel.
Activate Treasonous Ogre by paying 3 life, adding {R}.
Repeat step 5 until you have eight {R} available.
Activate Evra by paying {4}, exchanging its power with your life total.
Repeat from step 4.
1383-4827-5313.notes: The initial mana requirement assumes Evra has 4 power and your life total is 25-27 to start. The requirement can be reduced if Evra has greater power or if your life total is larger. At 25 life, you will not get infinite lifegain unless you supply an additional {1} to start, but you will get infinite lifegain at 26 or more life.

301-1099-4535.description:
Activate Sling-Gang Lieutenant by sacrificing Putrid Goblin
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters, Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin.
Resolve the Sling-Gang Lieutenant ability.
Repeat.

Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

4740-5078-5313-5741.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
If needed, activate Treasonous Ogre by paying 3 life, adding {R}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Repeat.

855-2060-2713-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

Cast Grim Monolith by paying its mana cost.
Flubs triggers, causing you to return Mox Opal from the battlefield to your hand, and causing each opponent to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind.
Repeat.

1235-1953-3057.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.

Move to your combat phase.

Repeat from step 2.

Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Banana, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Kibo.
Repeat from step 2.

713-1096-2034.notablePrerequisites: Woodfall Primus does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Woodfall Primus, adding {C}{C}.
When Woodfall Primus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Woodfall Primus enters the battlefield, it and Surrak and Goreclaw triggers.
Resolve the Surrak and Goreclaw trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Woodfall Primus and giving it haste until end of turn.
Holding priority, repeat from step 1.

1071-1494-1983-4017.notablePrerequisites: Sunbond attached to Sage of Hours.

Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1170-2480-3518.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Tamiyo.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Tamiyo's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, returning Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
